description: KS-CDM (sulfate-as-sole-sulfur-source chemically defined medium, 18 amino acids lacking cysteine/methionine) — a defined medium extracted from Tran et al. (2024). Mapped to BiGG from the paper's stated composition.

provenance.citation: Tran et al. Metabolic capabilities are highly conserved among human nasal-associated Corynebacterium species in pangenomic analyses. mSystems (2024). DOI: 10.1128/msystems.01132-24. [PMC11651106]
provenance.notes: Extracted from the primary paper (snippet: To test this, we generated a chemically defined agarose medium supplemented with 18 amino acids (lacking cysteine and methionine) in which 75 mM sodium sulfate was the only exogenous source of sulfur.). Component names mapped to BiGG (see mapping_confidence); presence-based bounds unless the paper gave exchange bounds; concentration_mM where units allowed. Extraction confidence: high.
provenance.verification_evidence: Final concentrations in KS-CDM were as follows: 37 mM potassium phosphate monobasic, 109 mM potassium phosphate dibasic, 63 mM sodium phosphate dibasic, 0.398 mM adenine, 0.398 mM cytosine, 0.398 mM uracil, 0.398 mM guanine, 8 mM tricine, 75 mM sodium sulfate ... 19 mM ammonium chloride ... 35 mM sodium chloride, 1.6 mM L-alanine ... 20mM L-serine ... 1.2 mM L-valine, and 0.1% Tween 80.
